kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
أطمئن (form IVq)
# أَطْمَئِنُّ (ʔaṭmaʔinnu) /ʔatˤ.ma.ʔin.nu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِطْمَأَنَّ (iṭmaʔanna)
# أَطْمَئِنَّ (ʔaṭmaʔinna) /ʔatˤ.ma.ʔin.na/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِطْمَأَنَّ (iṭmaʔanna)
# أَطْمَئِنِّ (ʔaṭmaʔinni) /ʔatˤ.ma.ʔin.ni/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِطْمَأَنَّ (iṭmaʔanna)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
